corrected_code:
from ninja import Router
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from ninja.errors import HttpError
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from post_office.models import EmailTemplate
from .schemas import EmailTemplateOutSchema

email_template_router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@email_template_router.get("/templates/{template_id}/preview", response=EmailTemplateOutSchema)
def preview_email_template(request, template_id: int):
    template = get_object_or_404(EmailTemplate, id=template_id)
    # Validate that the template belongs to the caller's tenant organization
    if template.language != request.auth.organization_slug and not request.auth.is_staff:
        raise HttpError(403, "Unauthorized access to email template")
    return {
        "id": template.id,
        "name": template.name,
        "subject": template.subject,
        "content": template.content,
        "html_content": template.html_content
    }
